classSteps: Class full? Get in touch to join the waitlist

paragraphs: Given there is a waitlist for many of our services, please provide as much notice as possible if you need to cancel or reschedule your booking so the time can be offered to another client.
Please give at least 12 hours’ notice if you need to cancel. Bookings cancelled with less than 12 hours’ notice are charged the full price.
cancellation.howTo: To cancel or reschedule, call us on
cancellation.howToNote: If we can’t answer, leave a voicemail: your notice counts from when you leave it, even outside opening hours.

classFacts.label: Private health
classFacts.value: Exercise sessions may be claimable, depending on your level of cover

studioEtiquette.name: Grip socks, please
studioEtiquette.detail: Grip socks are preferred on the equipment for hygiene and to help it last. They’re available to buy in the clinic, or bring your hospital or trampoline socks.

studioEtiquette.name: Shoes off, please
studioEtiquette.detail: Preferably no sneakers on the equipment. There’s a shoe rack outside to keep the dirt out.

studioEtiquette.name: Wearing orthotics?
studioEtiquette.detail: Sneakers are fine. Just let us know so we can adjust the setup for you.

booking.classes: Check availability and book classes online. Can’t see your preferred time? Call us to check or join the waitlist.
booking.bookingCode: Want to save time and avoid creating a new profile every time you book? Ask Nicole or Laura for your unique online booking code. Existing patients will also get a text with their patient portal sign-up link.
booking.portalNote: New to Embrace? Use **Book now**. The **Patient portal** is for existing patients who have a sign-up link.
booking.portalHint: For existing patients with a sign-up link
booking.callText: For more information or to speak to a member of our clinic team, call
